verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Merchant of Record add-on explicitly automates sales tax, VAT, and GST calculation and collection per sale, letting sellers avoid registering for tax in each market. However, it is documented as a beta feature limited to digital products only (physical goods unsupported), has restricted eligibility, and leaves refunds/disputes to the merchant — so it doesn't cover all transaction types a finance-ops user might need automated tax handling for. Missing for 10: general availability (non-beta) status, physical goods/product coverage, and independent/hands-on verification of tax accuracy across jurisdictions.
